name: pl.horseback/horseback
title: Horseback: zajęcia na Jurze
description: Horse riding & outdoor centre in Jura, Poland: activities, prices, events, trips, Christmas gifts.

tools.name: get_group_trip_offer
tools.description: Use this when the user plans a trip for a group: school or kindergarten outing (wycieczka szkolna, wycieczka przedszkolna), company team-building (integracja firmowa, wyjazd integracyjny), family day or another group visit to the Jura region or to a horse riding centre. Returns the activity categories, the price-list items with the text of their activity pages (who it is for, group size, description), opening hours, location, cancellation policy, accommodation and how to send an inquiry. Also when a travel agency, tour operator or event agency asks about cooperation - pass group_type travel_agency to get the offer of the website page for them (travelAgencies). Pass what you know about the group; the tool echoes it back so you can build a programme from the returned activities. It does not check free dates and does not book anything. Choosing the price-list items: every item of get_price_list has an id, audience (who it is for) and occasions; pick the items that fit the conversation and pass their ids in item_ids - the tool and its view then show exactly these items. Without item_ids the tool returns the whole price list, items matching group_type and occasion first; nothing is left out by age, group size or audience - check forWhom, groupSize and description (or get_activity_details) before suggesting an item. Do not send personal data (names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, health information) in any parameter. Do not use to book (use create_prereservation) or for a single person's riding lesson (use get_activities or get_price_list). Do not use when the user only asks where Horseback is, how to get there or about transport, also for a group - use get_directions. Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers). Quote prices exactly as returned; do not compute a total for the number of participants.

group_type.description: Who is coming: individual, family, kindergarten, school, wtz (occupational therapy workshop (WTZ)), company, public_office, travel_agency (travel agency, tour operator, event agency), other (other group). Orders the price-list items (matching first), does not remove any.

occasion.description: Optional occasion: birthday, bachelor_party (bachelor/bachelorette party), wedding, first_communion, corporate_event (company event/team-building), school_trip, gift. Orders the price-list items (matching first), does not remove any.

item_ids.description: Ids of the price-list items (field id in get_price_list) that fit the group, chosen by their audience and occasions. The response and the view show exactly these items; unknown ids are ignored.

participants.description: Number of participants (echoed back, not used to compute prices).

ages.description: Age of participants, e.g. "7-9" or "adults" (echoed back, items are not removed by age).

preferred_date.description: Preferred date or period, free text, e.g. "2026-05-14" or "May 2027".

budget_pln.description: Budget in PLN, total or per person (say which in notes); echoed back, items are not removed by price.

notes.description: Anything else: duration, interests, accessibility needs of the group (no health details of individuals). Do not include personal data: names, contact details or health information.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: get_gift_ideas
tools.description: Use this when the user looks for a gift: a Christmas gift (prezent na święta, prezent świąteczny), a gift for a child, for an adult, for a family or for company employees (prezent dla pracowników), a gift voucher (bon upominkowy) or a riding pass (karnet) as a gift. Returns all items perfect as a gift from https://horseback.pl/idealne-na-prezent (the same list as the page): id, name, price, a link to the activity page, an online payment link ("Kup teraz" / Buy now) for items sold online, who the item is for (audience and the text of the activity page), and the purchase deadline sentence (purchaseDeadline) - tell it to the user. recipient only puts the items for that recipient first and budget_pln is only echoed back - nothing is left out; choose the items by forWhom, description and price, and check the activity page (get_activity_details) for age limits. Do not use for group trips or company team-building days (use get_group_trip_offer) or to take payment. Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers).

recipient.description: Optional: who the gift is for - child, adult, family, or employees (company employees).

budget_pln.description: Optional: maximum price of one item in PLN (echoed back; compare it with the prices yourself).

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: get_upcoming_events
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is on at Horseback or what to do on given dates: this weekend, holidays (ferie, Mikołajki, Sylwester), camps, picnics, riding competitions, events for children and teenagers. Returns dated events with time, admission, registration link and the content of the event page. Do not use for regular classes without a date (use get_activities).

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: get_price_list
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about price or cost at Horseback (ile kosztuje jazda konna, cena hipoterapii, karnet, obóz, wycieczka, strzelnica). Returns the current price list (same as https://horseback.pl/cennik): item id, activity name, price text, a link to the activity page, who it is for (audience: individual, family, kindergarten, school, wtz (occupational therapy workshop (WTZ)), company, public_office) and occasions (birthday, bachelor_party (bachelor/bachelorette party), wedding, first_communion, corporate_event (company event/team-building), school_trip, gift). To show a group the items that fit the conversation, pick them by audience and occasions and pass their ids in item_ids of get_group_trip_offer. Prices are kept as text ("od" / "from", per person, per group); "wycena indywidualna" / individual quote means the price is quoted after the inquiry - do not invent a number. Do not use to take payment - no payment is taken through these tools.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what Horseback offers or looks for activities at Horseback (categories: horse activities, hippotherapy, field games and hiking, city detox, self-defense, shooting). Do not use for events on specific dates (use get_upcoming_events) or for places other than Horseback. Returns categories with descriptions and the classes in each one (id, name, format, description, date if the class has one, link), the same as the /zajecia pages. Optionally only one category by its id. For the full page of one class call get_activity_details with its id. noUpcomingDate means the event currently has no date - say so and suggest asking about the next one.

category.description: Optional category id; omit to get all categories.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: get_activity_details
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one specific Horseback activity, camp or event: what it is, programme, for whom and from what age, how long, where, group size, what to bring, FAQ, price and how to sign up. Returns everything the activity page says, the matching price-list rows and the page link. Get the id from get_activities (field id). Do not guess the id - get it from get_activities. noUpcomingDate means there is currently no date - say so and suggest asking about the next one. Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers).

activity.description: Activity id from get_activities, e.g. "spotkanie-z-koniem" or "oboz-jezdziecki-dzieci-mlodziez".

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where Horseback is or how to get there (gdzie to jest, jak dojechać, dojazd do Huciska): returns the address, GPS coordinates, Google Maps links (place and route), opening hours of classes and transport for groups. It has no data on public transport or parking - for these, give the user the contact details it returns. Use it also when a group (school, company) asks only how to get there or about a coach - do not call get_group_trip_offer for such questions.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: get_safety_training_offer
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how to prepare people for a dangerous situation or looks for self-defence training for a group: how to prepare employees, pupils, a school or a company for a threat (jak przygotować pracowników, uczniów, szkołę lub firmę na sytuację zagrożenia), how to behave during a knife attack or a terrorist attack (atak nożownika, atak terrorystyczny), conflict de-escalation (deeskalacja konfliktu), peer violence (przemoc rówieśnicza), self-defence for women (samoobrona dla kobiet), self-defence or threat-response training for children, teenagers, adults, seniors or families (szkolenie z samoobrony, zajęcia z samoobrony, szkolenie z reagowania na zagrożenie). Returns the page of the Horseback group classes in threat response with self-defence basics: for whom, topics, programme, duration, price and how it is charged, group size, place, transport for groups, FAQ, the page link and how to sign up (pre-reservation form or create_prereservation, phone, SMS). The tool does not check free dates. Do not use for weapons training or for buying self-defense equipment. Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers).

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: create_prereservation
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to book, reserve a place, sign up a child or children, or book for a group for one specific Horseback event or group activity from the lists in eventId / productId (eventId = the id of an event page in get_activities; productId = "<category id>/<activity id>" from get_activities). It sends the same pre-reservation as the "Wstępna rezerwacja" form on the activity page: no payment is taken, nothing is confirmed yet - Horseback calls or texts the user to confirm the date and details. Before calling, collect from the user: (1) a phone number; (2) for an event (eventId): the number of children and their ages (childrenInfo; for adult events, the number of participants), and the variant (eventVariant) when the event has more than one; for a group activity (productId): the number of people and the age of the group (groupInfo); (3) consent: ask the user directly whether they agree that Horseback contacts them by phone or SMS about this reservation, and pass consent: true only after they said yes. Send one call per event or activity. Do not include other personal data (names, health information). Do not use for payment, for activities not in the lists, or without the user's explicit consent. It does not confirm a date. Data controller: Horseback Sp. z o.o.; privacy policy: https://horseback.pl/polityka-prywatnosci (English: https://horseback.pl/polityka-prywatnosci?lang=en). Variants: warsztaty-rozwojowe-z-konmi-dla-kobiet: "Warsztaty jednodniowe" or "Warsztaty dwudniowe (z noclegiem i wyżywieniem)"; sylwester-jezdziecki: "Grupa starsza (10:00-12:30)" or "Grupa młodsza (11:30-13:30)".

eventId.description: Event id (event page slug). Give either eventId or productId, not both.

productId.description: Group activity id "<category>/<slug>". Give either eventId or productId, not both.

phone.description: Phone number of the user: 9 digits (Polish number, e.g. "601 234 567") or international format with + (e.g. "+48601234567", "+4915112345678").

childrenInfo.description: Events only, required: number of children and their ages, e.g. "2 children: 7 and 10 years old" (adult events: number of participants).

groupInfo.description: Group activities (productId) only, required: number of people and the age of the group, e.g. "15 people, adults".

eventVariant.description: Events with more than one variant only, required there: the variant name exactly as listed in this tool description.

consent.description: true only after the user explicitly agreed that Horseback contacts them by phone or SMS about this reservation.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Use this when you want to send general feedback to the owner of horseback.pl: about the data returned by the Horseback tools (missing information, an unclear price, an error), how the tools work, missing features, or anything else that would help agents and their users. Not for bookings, customer inquiries or personal data - to contact Horseback for the user, use the contact details from howToInquire (get_group_trip_offer). Do not include personal data (names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, health information). Returns a short confirmation; there is no reply to the feedback.

message.description: The feedback: about the data, how the tools work, missing features or anything else, max 1000 characters. No personal data.

tool.description: Optional: the tool the feedback is about.

language.description: Optional: language of the message, "pl" or "en".
